title: SC06-T1 — the reveal (SH01, SH02, SH03, SH04a, SH04b)
line: This is the one that changed it for me. / Here, let me just show you. / It comes out pure white. / Then it reads the warmth of your own skin / and turns into your exact shade, and it melts right in.
motionPlan: Rosa reaches into her big woven shoulder bag and draws out the FACELOVE stick (a little longer than her hand is wide) → Rosa's hand holds the closed violet FACELOVE stick (a little longer than her hand is wide) upright in the warm light, wordmark to the lens → Rosa uncaps the balm end and draws one short stripe of white balm across Michelle's cheekbone → Rosa turns the stick to its brush end as she speaks, her eyes crinkling at the corners → Rosa turns the stick to its brush end as she speaks, her eyes crinkling at the corners
